entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0.post3
entry.content:
# v2.2.0 (Prerelease): I Think I Like AHT Too Much... *Intended for use with game mod version 18 (see attachments).*
v2.2 contains *way* more than originally planned for it. It transitioned from "the next few things on my mind" to "do everything I can before I feel OK with putting it down for a bit". The to-do list still isn't totally empty, so there may still be a v2.3 in the relatively near future, but I don't anticipate any more *big* updates as there really aren't many other moderate-to-big sized features left to add at this point. # Changelog ## Hotfix 2 (~2:30am EDT Sept. 20th) * Fixed a secondary issue relating to costs for boss lairs/light gem doors/gadgets not getting appropriately randomized/shuffled. If you have hotfix 1, only the .apworld file needs to be updated for this fix (game mod and YAML are unchanged).
## Hotfix 1 (~7:30am EDT Sept. 19th) * Updated game mod from v17 -> v18, which contains a fix for a PAL-exclusive game-breaking bug in Gloomy Glacier (collectibles were not being tracked). Even if using NTSC, you need to update your mod to v18 to avoid the client giving a warning about incompatibility. * Fixed a few bugs with the in-game notifications, mainly affecting "sent \<item\> to \<player\>" messages. * Fixed a small typo that resulted in randomized costs for boss lairs/light gem doors/gadgets not actually being randomized. * Refactored the client's in-game map icon updating code to be more robust and easier to maintain. * Removed leftover text from the YAML referencing a scrapped feature idea.
## Multiple New or Redesigned/Expanded Features * The PAL GC version of the game is now supported by the game mod! Shoutouts to @BrinchEbsen for tons of work on the game mod in this update. * Logging system redesigned to be a single choice of level of detail. Warning messages from YAML issues are now always logged. * The randomized shop system has been moderately redesigned to take more advantage of the gem logic system introduced in v2.0. - `gem_logic` is now `shop_logic` and comes in 2 forms: - `ordered` works identically to `gem_logic = true`. - `unordered` is a replacement for `gem_logic = false` which completely removes the situation of having all shop items in logic in sphere 1. `unordered` will instead expect you to buy shop items in order as you gain access to enough gems to do them, but will not *restrict* you from buying them in another order if desired. - Also, `shop_item_count` lets you customize how many shop items you have, now separated from `key_rings`. * The goal system has been expanded to allow for customization of how many AHT checks you must do for each, instead of all-or-nothing. AHT is now capable of a much wider variety of seeds, and is better suited for shorter goal syncs now. 2 new types of goals were added, as well (talking to elders, and minigames). `/check_goal` was redesigned to better suit this redesign. * `auto_corrections` expanded to `fix_minor` and `fix_major`. Minor fixes are things that are relatively inconsequential, major have a more notable impact on the seed. * Added support for 4 traps (Spam Call, Reverse Controls, Gem Tax, and Damage Sparx)! The first 2 have a customizable length of time they last, and you can customize how much of the junk pool will be traps vs. filler. ## Other Things - Refactored/organized significant chunks of the codebase to be more smartly designed, particularly the item creation process. - Client commands have slightly better error checking now. Also added `/costs` as a convenience command that outputs various costs separately from `/list_options`. - Made an updated logic spreadsheet which lists every region and location access rule. May or may not be useful to the average person, but it's [here](<https://tinyurl.com/ahtapsheet>) for those interested in the internal logic rules (also pinned in the thread). - Map icons now render as red = unreachable, yellow = reachable, green = checked. - Every location was renamed to be less verbose, and they have a new ID mapping system which makes some features *way* easier to code. - Partially undid the custom sorting of locations in the tracker page. Locations are now sorted first in order of vanilla game levels, then alphabetically by logical region, then alphabetically by location. - "Generics" filler category is now called "Shinies". Same thing, they do nothing, just treat them like little shiny trinkets. - Added "Sent <item> to <player>" notifications in-game. None of us have any idea why they weren't there already, either...also added a small Easter egg when you receive a specific type of item from yourself :slight_smile: - Did you know there's some barrels and crates in Stormy Beach you can headbash? I didn't...their gems (270 total) are added to the gem logic system now. - `hint_boss_rewards` now hints all boss locations, not just the breath rewards. - Added location groups for Light Gem doors and gadgets. - Fixed an inconsequential logic bug in Magma Falls Bottom.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.5
entry.content:
Cerveau now has an item shop, the disk analysis screen got an open all button, and there are a bunch of new yaml options including itemsanity, randomized palettes, and more select button features. [Full Readme here](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) ## Features ### Cerveau's shop Cerveau now has a shop menu. Open his secret disk analysis screen and press L or R to access the shop page. Every slot is an Archipelago location, and buying one with E-Crystals sends the check. Items from other games appear as the Archipelago logo, with the background color indicating the progression type.
### Open all disks Pressing SELECT on the analysis screen now opens every disk you own at once. ### Itemsanity (option) Every static life capsule and E-Crystal pickup in the game can now be a location check, 82 in total. Enabled with the itemsanity option. The ten 1-UP checks are now an option too (`extra_life_sanity`), on by default. ### Randomized palettes (option) Randomized palettes draws every stage in a randomly picked color scheme. Enabled with its option.
### Cyber elf (option) `cyber_elves` has three settings. Affects fusion elves only, Satellite elves unchanged. - `vanilla`: how the game normally works. Upgrading elves costs crystals and fusing one hurts your rank. - `no_penalty`: fusing an elf doesn't affect your rank. - `auto`: every passive elf you receive from a disk is opened and applied on arrival, and Artan and Zictan just give you their sub tanks. No rank penalty. Makes the game a lot easier but gives it a nice sense of progression. ### SELECT button (option) The select button's functionality. Choose between Cycling the sub weapon (default), the main weapon, the head, body or foot chip, or use the fullest subtank. ### Disk name popup (option) When a secret disk arrives from Archipelago the game's message box displays its name and short description. ### Smaller stuff - `weapon_damage_upgrades` new option that turns off the last three steps of each progressive weapon (the damage boosts). - `start_inventory_from_pool` is supported. - Secret disk items are named `Disk 001: ...` instead of `Secret Disk 001: ...`. Some location names got shortened too, so heads up to anyone who has this names in their yaml. Sorry to @ambibii and their poptracker... ## Bug Fixes - Fixed bug where another player using `!collect` on your world could open the final stage even if you hadn't cleared every stage yourself. - Fix bug where the client would reporting "unknown location id 0" on killing a boss sometimes. - Boss portraits on the mission select screen would spin around as they faded in once you had cleared a stage.

entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.2.4
entry.content:
**⚠️ Existing seeds must be regenerated.** Location names and item classifications changed, so a run generated on v0.2.3 or earlier will not work with this build. Finish it on the old version or reroll.
### Fixed
- **The Skill Shop sometimes opened as the normal shop instead of the AP shop** — capsule purchases didn't send checks, and the client froze for several seconds at a time. The shop now loads AP stock reliably and without the stall. - **Crash when entering your first Dragon Arena fight** after picking a stage. - **Winning a fight sometimes sent a DeathLink death.** If the KO registered just before the results screen appeared, your win was reported as a death. - **Quitting a Dragon Arena fight sent its death at the wrong moment** — it stayed queued and fired later, usually when you next walked into the arena. It now fires when you quit. - **Seeds with ShopSanity off:** the Skill Shop was emptied on every entry, so you couldn't buy anything with your Zeni. - **Kid Gohan's Frieza fight was mislabeled** as First Form — it's Third Form.
### Changed
- **Fight names are consistent.** Frieza uses ordinals (`Frieza 1st/2nd/3rd/Final Form`); Cell uses his real form names (`Imperfect Cell`, `Semi-Perfect Cell`, `Perfect Cell`) instead of a mix of numbers and parentheticals. - **Skill capsules are now `useful` instead of filler** — all 11 Breakthroughs plus every DU character ability (transformations, signature attacks, Unlock Potential, fusions). They're weighted better in placement and surface in trackers and hints. They still aren't required by logic.
### New
- **`/deathlink`** toggles DeathLink on or off mid-run from the client, and it sticks across reconnects.

entry.title: Custom Robo v1.0
entry.content:
**"A New Journey is about to commence! Now let me think about the order of events again..."**
### Custom Robo - V1.0 Release
The capabilities of the Memory Erasure Device are quite potent! So much so that our hero seems to have forgotten how everything played out... but not to worry! Those memories must be SOMEWHERE around the Multiworld...
Ah, and don't forget Dad's Watch! We'll need that too before we can go face the Outside World.
Features: ### **Progression is now gated behind the day's memories! You'll be needing those to relive each chapter of the adventure, because if you can't remember you'll simply have to repeat the current day until it comes to you.**
The following items are now part of the pool: - Chapter 3 Memories: gives access to License Test - Chapter 4 Memories: gives access to Family Matters - Chapter 5 Memories: gives access to the Bogey Tournament (and ultimately Shiner) - Chapter 6 Memories: gives access to the Gym Tournament - Chapter 7 Memories: gives access to Lab Guard Duty - Chapter 8 Memories: gives access to your first encounter with Rahu at Bogey's - Chapter 9 Memories: gives access to the Police 2v2 Tournament - Chapter 10 Memories: gives access to the secret S-Rank trials - Chapter 11 Memories: gives access to Rahu's return at Daimon - Dad's Watch: gives access to the Outside World (Go Mode)
(Do note that you'll need to collect all of your Memories to ultimately get through the New Journey to defeat Rahu III!)
### **Tired of talking to people? Great news! Several flag edits have been added to the client to suppress the need to TalkToEveryone (and Lucy in several places... sorry Lucy)**
The following chapters now operate as follows: - Chapter 1: You can talk to Harry to immediately leave the Lab after fighting the bandits - Chapter 5: You can talk to the Waiter to immediately start the Bogey Tourney - Chapter 6: Sophie is NOT waiting for you to talk with everyone, she now starts the Gym Tournament immediately - Chapter 7: You can talk to Harry to immediately progress to the next scene (no more running around the Lab!) - Chapter 9: You can just go talk with the Chief to start the Police 2v2 Tournament
### **Chapters can now be shuffled/randomized as a YAML option! When connecting, the Client will display your chapter order so you know which memories you'll need to progress.**
### **By popular demand, a new starting inventory option has been added: full Oil Can Parts**

entry.title: Taskipelago v1.2.0rc0
entry.content:
*The big region overhaul (and also clicker game mode)*
## What's new (v1.2.0) * New types of item grouping definitions. Now progressive, aesthetic, or random-choice * aesthetic groups merely group things aesthetically with no effect on progression or not. * random-choice groups randomly choose N or N% as you define items from within the group to be included in the world. No tasks may depend on individual items in these groups since they aren't guaranteed to exist, but depending on the randomized group as a whole or by percentage/count is supported. * progressive groups function the same as always * Regions can now also be randomized to include N or N% of tasks within that region. May optionally also shuffle the order in which such tasks appear. * Subregions can now be defined within regions that aren't randomized (subregions may be randomized). * Regions may now depend on items and tasks via the syntax item(expr) and task(expr) where expr is any valid task or item dependency expression * Tasclickpelago toggle on the yaml generator that enables a bunch of features for building out an idle game because the concept was funny and I thought of a way to do it well. * Style tab added to the YAML generator so you can recolor the entire application at will while connected to the slot in question. Pretty colors are pretty.
Note: should be fully backwards compatible with worlds generated from 1.0 onwards. Also Universal Tracker is still incompatible.
